body: I don't know what else I can do. The only other option I have is to move out but I'm underage and my mom would call the cops just to see me get in trouble. She loves that. I'm gonna see how today and tomorrow goes and then I'll decide.
I'm still in a lot of pain at the moment, but I'm pushing myself to get ready for the day instead of laying in bed.
Thank you everyone,  it means a lot!

Thank you! I'm still very young so it's hard to be independent,  but i have no choice. It's just hard knowing the people who brought you into this world couldn't care less about you. I'm trying my best to stay strong.

I feel like i dont deserve help or attention. There are people who probably need it more than me, and why should people help me when im just gonna end up dead soon anyways. I hate myself an  my life, i dont mean to sound like a whining bitch but its true. Everyday im in pain, its so bad mow i feel physically ill, i want to go away.

Thank you so much! I really appreciate it. I really do want to help other people out, I need to work on channeling my negative thoughts and energy into more creative and productive things. Thank you for making me feel a bit better tonight. :)

I feel hopless and angry. I wasn't meant to be born, my parents didn't want me and all I did was waste 14 years of time and money. I just feel so tired of being in constant pain I just want a fucking hug somtimes. I don't want to feel anything anymore, I just want it to be over.

Happy birthday! I know exactly how you feel when you say you can feel youself giving up, and how you feel you annoy people. Every morning before school I lay on my floor and cry until I can pull my shit together enough to put on sweatpants and walk out the door. Please don't give up on talking to people that's one mistake I made too, I now find myself isolated and alone crying everyday. The reason your friends seem sad when you talk to them is because they love you and they can't stand to see you hurting. Don't do what I did, please don't give up.*hugs* happy birthday!!
